note: Randolph County, AR publishes no zoning district service found in ArcGIS Online/Hub or county sites. The county seat, Pocahontas (largest city), publishes its zoning only as a PDF city zoning map (linked from its Code Enforcement page), which is not a queryable service. Other searches found only commercial parcel products. The county's own GIS and planning pages were not reachable or list no zoning layer.
